name: calm-typescript
description: Спокойные ошибки JS/TS, плавный курсор и сохранение после паузы.

commands.title: Calm TypeScript: Reset Managed Editor Settings

calmTypeScript.quietMode.description: Show diagnostics on every affected line at 95% transparency, including Error Lens text. Validation, IntelliSense and build checks stay enabled.

calmTypeScript.smoothTyping.description: Enable native smooth caret animation, smooth blinking and scrolling.

calmTypeScript.typingPulse.description: Briefly highlight the latest newly typed character without changing source text.

calmTypeScript.autoSaveAfterTyping.description: Save dirty local files after typing pauses when native afterDelay Auto Save is not already active.

calmTypeScript.autoSaveDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds for the extension's pause-based save. Native files.autoSaveDelay takes precedence when native afterDelay mode is enabled.
